rationale: The blackbox declaration supplies no implementation or reviewed launch/reset/output model for x. Timing din to clk cannot establish how the opaque cell drives x or whether downstream capture is safe. A synchronizer-like cell name is not evidence.

labels.rationale: The blackbox has no behavioral or clock/reset transfer model. Input timing does not establish the domain or safety of x. Cannot establish the output contract or that opaque_sync actually synchronizes.

opaque_sync has no behavioral or reviewed library model. Its name and clk pin cannot establish output launch domain, synchronization, or reset behavior. The subsequent dout capture cannot be certified; the blackbox disclosure itself is the intended unknown.
